name: shell-adr-commit
description: A decision document written and committed through the shell in one turn (git status is clean afterwards, so the mtime fallback finds nothing) is still found: the repo's HEAD recorded at the turn's first prompt moved, and git diff names the document. A commit of ordinary code asks nothing.

payload.prompt: write up the queue decision and commit it

tool_input.command: printf '# ADR-9: Queues\n' > docs/adr/ADR-9.md && git add -A && git commit -qm 'ADR-9'

files.docs/adr/ADR-9.md:
# ADR-9: Queues

Work is queued per tenant.
